_note: First non-hero asset (docs/ART-REDO.md). The concept crop is the goblin group in monsters.jpg (the registry crop 16,328,236,246); the views draw one goblin with a single spear (no torch, no axe). The style reference is the approved engineer front view, so the goblin shares the hero render. The views hold the spear upright, so the 50 px figure height includes the spear tip, like the old 18-unit card. World height 18 is monsterHeights.goblin; at the hero texel (32/88) that is 50 px. view_notes.E is the stronger wording the E view was regenerated with after the first take lost the spear.
source_note: the reference shows three goblins; draw only one goblin with their look, holding one spear and nothing else
design: small hunched goblin with mossy green skin, long pointed ears, glowing orange eyes, two small lower tusks, ragged dark brown leather tunic with a wide belt and a leather strap across the chest, bare green arms, brown cloth wraps on the shins and feet
gait: Quick hunched goblin walk: knees bent, legs alternating clearly, slight body bob

items.name: short wooden spear with a grey iron spearhead
items.walk: spear held low and angled forward in his right hand, tip no higher than his ears

view_notes.E: He clearly holds a short wooden spear with a grey iron spearhead upright in his right hand, the hand nearest the camera: the spear is fully visible in front of his body, spearhead above his head, shaft ending near his feet.

attack: leans forward and jabs the spear straight ahead in the facing direction and pulls it back
death: staggers backwards, drops the spear and falls flat on the ground

check._note: anchors: concept colours (hero_sprites.py goblin colours) the palette keeps within dE 15. roles: iron is the spearhead and buckle; leather the tunic, wraps, spear shaft and shadows (dark browns are under 0.12 chroma, so the neutral role takes them); ochre the eyes and inner ears. The orange eyes are one or two px at 50 px, so ochre is a ceiling on the back, not a floor on the front. prop_dirs: all eight, the spear is off the body midline in every start pose.

back.title: back view N: no eyes or inner ears, the tunic back

front.title: front view S keeps the face, the tunic and the spearhead
